title: Run the game once, unchanged
body:
Make sure your copy builds and passes its quick tests:

```sh
npm ci && node tools/kit.mjs check
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: Start the CASTLE RAID minigame
check: npm run build && node --test test/mg-keep.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
body:
Castles that last between games need a different kit (see docs/design.md), so the raid comes first, as a round of Party:

```sh
node tools/new-mg.mjs keep kk "CASTLE RAID"
```

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-keep.test.mjs test/party.test.mjs
```

Want Claude to do it? Comment `@claude please do this task` on this issue.

title: 30 seconds to stack a castle
body:
At the start of a round each player stacks a small castle on their spot.

Check:

```sh
npm run build && node --test test/mg-keep.test.mjs
```

title: Knock castles down; the last one standing wins
body:
After the build, roll into the other castles to knock them down.

Check:

```sh

```

title: See it on your page
body:
Turn on your page once: Settings > Pages > Source: GitHub Actions. Then `client/party.html?mg=30` plays CASTLE RAID.

```sh
npm run build && node tools/site.mjs
```
